remarks: Lovely cottage located on single family home property in North Stamford. Impeccably kept, this sweet home is perfect for anyone looking for a peaceful place to call home. Nestled on a single family property, you will have your own private space. Living room with hardwood floors, lots of windows and vaulted ceilings. The open floor plan leads into a chic kitchen with granite countertops, tile floor, and sparkling appliances. 1/2 bath completes the first floor. Up the spiral staircase, you will find a bedroom with hardwood floors and a private full bathroom. Plenty of closet space as well as a full size washer and dryer for your convenience. You will have a parking space right outside the front door as well as garage parking (1 car). Enjoy your private patio that you can set up for enjoying the outdoors. All utilities (except for cable, internet, streaming), are covered by the owner who lives in the main house. We require references, excellent credit, and a clean, quiet individual who will respect the property. This one is a gem! ABSOLUTELY NO PETS! NO ONE IS PERMITTED ON THE PROPERTY WITHOUT A LICENSED REALTOR
